verdict.stance: Underweight / Deconsolidated Russia + Beer Volume Pressure Lifting Gross Leverage (BB Neg)
verdict.summary: Fitch affirmed Anadolu Efes at BB with Negative Outlook in Nov-26 as 9M26 domestic beer volumes dropped ~15% YoY and loss of Russian JV dividends leaves Beer Group carrying elevated standalone debt (Fitch projects ~4.7x YE26 gross leverage). 50.3% control of Coca-Cola İçecek (CCI) remains the core credit anchor.

positives: Controlling 50.3% ownership of high-margin, low-leverage Coca-Cola İçecek (CCI, 0.3x net leverage at 9M26).
Leading market shares in Turkey, Kazakhstan, Georgia, and Moldova beer markets.
2028 USD Eurobond maturity provides medium-term runway.
negatives: Fitch Negative Outlook (Nov-26) with projected YE26 gross leverage of ~4.7x.
Deconsolidation/loss of Russian JV cash flows and 15% drop in 9M26 Turkish beer volumes.
Negative FY25 consolidated FCF (-TRY 4.18bn) due to capex and interest costs.

background.business_overview: Turkish beverage conglomerate operating Beer Group across Turkey/CIS and consolidating Coca-Cola İçecek (50.3%).
background.asset_perimeter: Beer operations in Turkey, Kazakhstan, Georgia, Moldova + 50.3% stake in CCI.
background.ownership_governance: Anadolu Group (43%) and AB InBev (24%); Borsa Istanbul listed (AEFES).

recent_drivers: Nov-26: Fitch affirmed BB / Negative Outlook, projecting ~4.7x YE26 gross leverage; 9M26 Turkish beer volume -15% YoY.

management_guidance_tracker.management_target: Reduce Fitch gross leverage from ~4.9x (FY24) toward <3.5x
management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Russian JV loss and -15% domestic beer volume keep gross leverage stretched.

management_questions.question: Provide Beer Group standalone net debt and cash balance excluding CCI consolidated cash.

management_questions.question: Detail 2027 capex cuts and working capital plans to reverse negative FCF ahead of Jun-28 bond maturity.

annotations.note: Fitch affirmed BB / Negative Outlook in Nov-26 on 9M26 -15% Turkish beer volumes and ~4.7x projected YE26 gross leverage.

recovery_analysis.thesis: 50.3% equity stake in CCI underpins enterprise value above Beer Group debt.
